description: React component for rendering a custom roadmap with interactive features such as updating progress, handling clicks, and rendering a read-only editor.

classes.name: FlowRoadmapRenderer
classes.description: React functional component for rendering and managing a roadmap with interactive progress updates and event handling.

methods.name: updateTopicStatus
methods.description: Asynchronously updates the status of a topic, handles UI feedback, and refreshes progress counters.

methods.name: handleTopicRightClick
methods.description: Handles right-click events on topics to toggle their status between 'done' and 'pending'.

methods.name: handleTopicShiftClick
methods.description: Handles shift-click events on topics to toggle their status between 'learning' and 'pending'.

methods.name: handleTopicAltClick
methods.description: Handles alt-click events on topics to toggle their status between 'skipped' and 'pending'.

methods.name: handleTopicClick
methods.description: Dispatches a custom event when a topic is clicked.

methods.name: handleLinkClick
methods.description: Handles clicks on links, opening external links in a new tab or navigating internally.

methods.name: handleChecklistCheckboxClick
methods.description: Toggles checklist item status between 'done' and 'pending'.

methods.name: handleChecklistLabelClick
methods.description: Toggles checklist label status between 'done' and 'pending'.
